title: Pushing a Model Aircraft: Force and Acceleration
learningObjectives: Predict acceleration in one dimension from net force and constant mass.
Explain that zero net force maintains constant velocity in a straight line.
Describe that acceleration increases with force and decreases with mass.

evidence.quote: If there is no net force acting on the object, then the object will maintain a constant velocity.
This tendency to resist changes in a state of motion is inertia.

explanations.text: With no net external force an object keeps constant velocity in a straight line. Changing that state requires an unbalanced external force.

evidence.quote: The acceleration of an object depends on the mass of the object and the amount of force applied.

explanations.text: For constant mass, net force equals mass times acceleration. Acceleration grows with force and shrinks with mass.

evidence.quote: Remember that this relation is only good for objects that have a constant mass.
Scientists and mathematicians call this a vector quantity.

explanations.text: The force-mass-acceleration relation assumes constant mass. Force, velocity, acceleration and momentum have magnitude and direction.

behavioralTests.name: zero net force means zero acceleration
